descriptor.name: California Statewide Parcels Public View (CAL FIRE)
descriptor.scope: Statewide California county-parcel compilation (58 county FIPS codes present, 13,138,000 rows on 2026-10-12). Canonical identity is the county FIPS code plus the county assessor parcel number; the 23,032 rows without an APN are outside this source.

evidence: https://www.arcgis.com/sharing/rest/content/items/2061fbc963464c5198ec064100802624?f=json — Publisher describes parcel boundaries for property identification, assessment, and statewide land records mapping; assembled from county parcel sources.

Frozen packet identifies the CAL FIRE statewide California county-parcel compilation; Modesto samples use Stanislaus county FIPS 06099. Safe live exact-ID/native queries verify these polygons in the supplied Modesto area; no citywide completeness is inferred.
